name: urba-prode-monorepo
description: Plataforma de pronósticos deportivos (Prode) para el rugby de la URBA - Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WORKER,FRONT" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:front"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd prode-back && npm install && cd ../prode-front && npm install

author: Stefano Pellegrino
